neighbours.label: the second piece of a hyphenated or fused two-part compound (claw|-foot, static|_ip, post|paid, open-|ice, black| ice)
fire: The antique dealer on the corner was selling a heavy oak table with a single drop-leaf that folds down against the wall.
The deployment script looks up each machine in the inventory and writes its private_ip into the hosts file.
The old barn door is kept closed with a rusty thumb-latch that sticks whenever it rains.
Scouts liked the young winger because he created so many open-ice hits without taking penalties.
Before seeding, the field was worked twice with a goose-foot cultivator to kill the weeds.
The carrier lets subscribers move from a pay-as-you-go card to a postpaid plan after six months.
The monitoring agent tags every address it finds as either internal_ip or external before sending the report.
The road crews spread salt all night because drivers kept sliding on black ice near the river crossing.
quiet: The antique dealer on the corner was selling a heavy oak table with a single drawer that sticks against the frame.
The deployment script looks up each machine in the inventory and writes its name into the hosts file.
A rusty chain keeps the old barn door closed, and it sticks whenever it rains.
Scouts liked the young winger because he created so many chances without taking penalties.
The field was worked twice with a heavy cultivator before seeding, to kill the weeds.
Subscribers of the carrier can move from a monthly bill to a yearly plan after six months.
The monitoring agent marks every address it finds as either internal or external before sending the report.
Drivers kept sliding on the bridge near the river crossing, so the road crews spread salt all night.

notes: Weak pole (max 4.69); probes of this pattern reached only 0.11-0.27 of max, so the median may fall short of 0.20.
